about: The official 55-trophy PS5 list for Grand Theft Auto VI, with a guide, kind, counter and missable flag added by PLATINUM ROAD for each trophy.
sourceLine: Official PS5 trophy list — via Exophase and PSNProfiles
sources: Official PS5 trophy list, as published by Exophase
Official PS5 trophy list, as published by PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This is the reward for finishing the whole list, so treat it as a progress meter rather than a task of its own. Work the roadmap stage by stage, heed the missable watch before story points of no return, and let the checklist show you what is left. When the other 54 are stamped, this one pops by itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission of the game, so the opportunity cannot be missed — play through Gone Fishing until the completion banner lands. It doubles as the tutorial stretch, so use it to learn the controls, the phone and how swapping between the two leads works.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission filed under Chapter 1 of the story. Nothing in a chapter is optional, and the trophy lands the moment the chapter wraps, so no preparation is needed beyond following the story markers on the map.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the campaign. By now the map is opening up, but resist the urge to wander off for good — chapters gate later strands and activities, so keep the story moving and let the side content fill the gaps between missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The city is fully yours by this point; if a stranger strand is sitting open on your map, it is worth clearing it around now, before the later chapters start closing doors — see the missable watch for why.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. You are into the back half of the story, so this is a good moment to sweep up open character strands and any collectible route you have been putting off, while every door is still open.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Reach the end of the campaign and finish the final mission. Before you start it, make a separate manual save — endings and late choices are exactly what the missable watch warns about. If any character strand is still open, finish it first so nothing is left locked behind the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: A named story mission: play Breakfast Run when its marker appears and see it through to the completion banner. Build the habit of saving before any story mission and this whole class of trophy never becomes a problem.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a set-piece story mission, so treat it as a small point of no return for anything tied to its crew and location. Bank a manual save before you begin, finish any nearby side business first, then run the heist through to its completion banner.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its completion banner. Like every named mission trophy, it needs nothing more exotic than finishing the job the story hands you — follow the markers and do not abandon the mission mid-way.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. If a firefight section keeps ending the run, fall back, let your health recover and push in stages — the trophy only cares about the completion banner, not a flawless clear.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Airport jobs tend to end loud, so arrive with armour and a full weapon wheel, and the completion banner should follow without drama.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. An 'operation' in the title usually means a scripted set-piece that the story will not offer twice, so it sits on the missable watch as a precaution: save before you start, and tie off loose ends in the area first.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The long haul: the in-game completion counter must read a full 100%, spanning story, strands, collectibles and a slice of every activity. Use the kind and grade filters here to find whatever is still grey, and lean on the counters for the grind trophies. Save it for the final mile — most of it fills in while you chase everything else.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps and stunt moments all over Leonida count toward the 250, so grab air whenever the world offers a ramp, a rooftop or a conveniently angled truck. Stunt spots can be repeated, so a favourite ramp can be farmed in a loop. Weave them into normal driving instead of saving all 250 for one sore evening, and log them on the counter as you go.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida has nine activity types — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races and friends — and you need only a single attempt at each. It is a sampler platter: start one of everything once, even if you walk away straight after. The activity cards in the checklist make it easy to spot a type you have not touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon class on its own range first, then chase the score lines once the target patterns feel predictable. On most boards accuracy bonuses beat raw speed, so slow down half a beat rather than rushing a string of shots.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone handling is twitchy, so run each course once to learn the gates before racing it for the win. Wins are per location, so tick them off on the counter as you travel the state.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Any twenty different races count — street, off-road, boat or air — as long as each is a distinct event. Re-running the same race does not add to the tally, so keep moving to fresh start lines on the map. The counter here keeps the running total honest.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the benchmark angler in the fishing challenges; out-score him in any one of them. Upgrade your tackle as the shops allow and learn where the bigger fish hold before you issue the challenge. A bad round costs nothing — re-cast and rematch him whenever you like.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet in Leonida and play one game through to its end screen. It does not matter which cabinet or how well you score — completion is the whole requirement. An easy early tick for the checklist.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand whenever his marker is on the map and this lands at his final mission. Strand finals sit on the missable watch by precaution: finish strands before pushing deep into the late chapters, and keep a rolling save so a strand can never be locked away from you.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: See Kenton's strand through to his final mission. When his icon reappears after a job, the chain is still running — go back promptly rather than letting it sit while the story moves on. A save kept from before the strand's end is cheap insurance, per the missable watch.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand at his final mission. Lone-rider types tend to vanish once their story is done, so treat every Billy marker as time-sensitive: clear his jobs as they appear and this trophy takes care of itself.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers scattered across Leonida. A strand is a chain, not a single job: when a stranger's icon returns after a mission, the story is not finished with them yet. Finish strands promptly — the missable watch flags them because late story progress can close their doors for good.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Run Randy's strand to its final mission. Supply runs are the strand's bread and butter, so expect driving under pressure; a fast, tough vehicle in your garage makes the last jobs noticeably calmer. Keep the strand moving whenever his marker is up.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand at his final mission. As with every strand final on the missable watch, the safe play is boring and effective: do the jobs as they appear, keep a recent save, and never let a strand dangle into the endgame.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots hide at scenic overlooks all over Leonida — cliffs, piers, rooftops and quiet beaches. Sit at all 18; the interaction is short and the counter tracks them. They make a relaxing collectible route to run between heavier grinds.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret sends you after a unique animal — a specific hunt, not open-season hunting. Follow the clues his strand gives you and carry decent firepower; a unique animal will not go down like roadside deer. Finish the hunt and report back to close it out.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered through the world in themed sets; complete any three full sets. Cards glint on shelves, counters and dashboards, so search interiors thoroughly rather than only rooftops. The counter tracks sets, not single cards — finish one set at a time instead of spreading thin.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a pure numbers grind, so weave fresh locations into trips you are already making and log them on the counter. New districts are the fastest source of spots you have not used yet.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's bite-size feats — driving, combat, exploration and more. Fifty sounds like a lot, but they accumulate naturally while you play everything else. Check the counter now and then, and deliberately mop up whichever category is lagging behind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Raise your wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat fully clears — the escape must complete with your partner still alongside. Tunnels, parking structures and quick vehicle swaps help you vanish. If the stars fade before your partner is present, stir things up and try again.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level fully expire in between. Plan a small circuit of nearby stores, keep the car running outside each one, and move the moment the till is empty. Losing the wanted level resets the chain, so keep the pressure simmering instead of hiding.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in and drive it, so steal broadly — every new model you sit in adds one. Parking lots, dealerships and rich neighbourhoods are showrooms for this trophy. At 100 you will have sampled a good slice of Leonida's traffic; the counter keeps score.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in front of you and drop all five before the effect ends. Crowded gang spots and police standoffs make ideal setups. Line the shots up before you activate it — the clock only starts once the focus does.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — think less boarding pass, more stealing your exit. It reads as a one-off story moment, so it is on the missable watch: when the story takes you to VCIA, look for the unruly way out before the mission moves on, and let a save from before the visit be your safety net.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and this trophy wants you to deal with them — expect heavy armour and a bad attitude. Bring explosives or a heavy vehicle of your own and use cover; do not trade shots in the open. The description is coy, so experiment: hijacking, disabling or destroying one should reveal what counts.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected — no guard spotting you, no witness finishing a call. Case the store first, learn the patrol pattern, and go in masked and quiet. If you are seen, walk away and reset rather than forcing it; a clean run is the entire trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Crack five bank vaults and escape with the take. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery menu, so bring your partner, a fast car, and an escape route that does not cross the whole city. Each clean getaway adds one to the counter — five and the silver is yours.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on its rounds, rob it, and escape the response. The rear doors are the weak point; hit it somewhere you can vanish quickly afterwards. One successful truck is all this takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Leonida is divided into 52 named areas, and you need to set foot in every one. Most reveal themselves through story and strands; the last few are usually swamp, island or mountain corners nobody visits. When the counter stalls in the high forties, tour the map edges systematically.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run Leonida, and each runs illegal operations — rob one belonging to every gang. The counter tracks gangs, not operations, so variety matters more than volume. Expect a fight each time: these are defended premises, not open shops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. It reads like a scripted early moment — the trophy is even called In The Beginning — so it sits on the missable watch. If you are near the start of the game, take the moment while the beach is in front of you instead of assuming you can stroll back for it later.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Inside a vehicle showroom, get into a car and smash your way out through the glass in classic style. Pick something with a bit of weight, aim for the windows, and enjoy the insurance paperwork. One dramatic exit completes it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through there — play the game the alley offers. It is a light activity tick; pair it with the arcade trophy for an evening of Leonida leisure between heavier work.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — deliberately vague, and the vagueness is why it is on the missable watch. It likely hinges on a specific shared moment with your partner, so when a scene presents the two of you together in front of an audience, take it. Keep saves around partner-heavy story beats just in case.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The game quietly counts the choices you make, and PSN tracks the total toward 500. Most players get there simply by playing — dialogue picks, mission approaches and everyday decisions all feed it. Because choices can also close doors, it is flagged on the missable watch as a precaution; if you are short late in the game, keep playing side content and the counter keeps moving.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail at something the game lets you retry, then succeed on the follow-up attempt. The phrasing suggests a scripted moment rather than free play, so it is flagged on the missable watch. When a mission or scene offers an immediate second chance after a failure, take it — that is almost certainly the moment.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides weird encounters, and this trophy is for stumbling into one. It is on the missable watch because scripted oddities rarely repeat. Explore at night, follow up strange map behaviour and stranger rumours, and when something feels staged and bizarre, stay and watch it play out.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing from a moving vehicle and connect as you pass. Low speed is your friend: roll along the sidewalk and time the swing at the closest point. It may take a few passes to land cleanly; nobody said bowling was gentle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills from scores need washing: run them through your contacts until $250,000 has been laundered. It is a money loop rather than a single job, so build the habit early and feed bills into the laundry whenever you pass a contact. The counter steps in thousands to keep the tally painless.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a hundred thousand dollars across Leonida's shops in total — clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all count. You will cover most of it just by playing and upgrading; if you are short near the end, a garage-filling shopping spree closes the gap. Track it on the counter in big round steps.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on the market — eight in total. They form the most expensive shopping list in the game, so this pairs naturally with the laundering and spending trophies. Buy them as your money grows instead of saving for one splurge at the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten of your vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a keeper — a car you actually park and reuse — register it straight away so the habit builds the count for you. Ten registrations is a small fleet; the counter keeps score.
trophies.name: On the Spot
